subject.title: plugin-sdk: restore legacy compat helper exports

question: Should `openclaw/plugin-sdk/compat` permanently expose this specific 20-helper legacy alias set for external plugin migration?
rationale: The aliases cross multiple internal owner boundaries and become public compatibility obligations; source inspection can validate mechanics, but it cannot decide which historical imports maintainers intend to support.

options.title: Approve a narrowed restoration
options.body: Restore only aliases tied to demonstrated shipped external-plugin usage, update every target to its current owner module, and retain focused subpaths as the documented destination.

options.title: Reject the alias expansion
options.body: Keep the compatibility entrypoint limited to its current contract and require affected external plugins to migrate directly to focused SDK subpaths.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrowed restoration
recommendation.body: Restore only aliases tied to demonstrated shipped external-plugin usage, update every target to its current owner module, and retain focused subpaths as the documented destination.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent compatibility registry and migration infrastructure is the closest history-backed ownership signal for deciding the permanent compatibility boundary.
